text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
* A bill to provide total religious freedom has been prepared for public debate. It would give sects equal status to churches.
* TAP-Air Portugal pilots' overtime strike called for March 15 looks less likely to take place after talks between the airline and unions yesterday.
* Emergency wings of hospitals are inefficient, according to a report prepared by the Inspectorate-General of Health.
* Portugal Telecom expected to define its strategic alliance this month. The last round of talks with potential partners is due to start tomorrow.
* Portugal Telecom posted 1996 net profits of 54.9 billion escudos, 51.5 pct more than in 1995.
